rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for cotton fiber and, in context, the cotton plant.

example.english: The jacket is padded with cotton, so it keeps you warm in winter.
example.traditional: 件衫入面填咗棉花，冬天着好暖。
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 jap6 min6 tin4 zo2 min4 faa1 dung1 tin1 zoek3 hou2 nyun5

rows.note: Use this for loose, fluffy cotton fiber or cotton fluff rather than cotton as a general material.

example.english: The cotton fluff has come out of the pillow and is everywhere.
example.traditional: 枕頭入面啲棉絮甩咗出嚟，周圍都係。
example.jyutping: zam2 tau4 jap6 min6 dik1 min4 seoi5 lat1 zo2 ceot1 lei4 zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for cloth or fabric made from cotton.

example.english: I want to buy a pair of cotton trousers; they are more comfortable in summer.
example.traditional: 我想買條棉布褲，夏天着舒服啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 tiu4 min4 bou3 fu3 haa6 tin1 zoek3 syu1 fuk6 di1

rows.note: Use this when you mean the cotton plant itself rather than its fiber.

example.english: They planted several cotton plants over there, and they look beautiful when they flower.
example.traditional: 嗰邊種咗幾棵棉花樹，開花嗰陣好靚。
example.jyutping: go2 bin1 zung3 zo2 gei2 fo2 min4 faa1 syu6 hoi1 faa1 go2 zan6 hou2 leng3
